_read_me: You can change the numbers and word lists below right on GitHub. Click the pencil icon, edit, then click Commit changes. The next hourly update uses the new settings.
_neca_store_help: Also show figures that are in stock or on pre-order at the official NECA store (store.necaonline.com).
_shipping_help: Only used if a SHIP_TO_ZIP variable is set on GitHub. Listings with calculated shipping are looked up to get the real price to that ZIP. Each listing is looked up once and remembered.
_must_have_help: A title must contain at least one of these, so other brands (Hasbro, McFarlane, Hot Toys and so on) never show up. Reel Toys is NECA's own label.
_hide_words_help: Any listing whose title contains one of these words or phrases is hidden. They usually mean the figure is opened, used, loose, fake, a bundle, or not a figure at all.
_maybe_hide_words_help: These words often mean a loose figure, so the listing is hidden UNLESS the title also says sealed, NIB, MISB, MOC or new in box.
_hide_pairs_help: A title is hidden when it has BOTH words of any pair. These catch sellers' bundles of two different figures.
_box_warning_help: Listings that mention these words still show up (the figure is still sealed) but get a yellow 'box damage mentioned' tag.
_ok_phrases_help: These phrases are ignored before checking the lists above, so 'never opened' does not count as 'opened' and 'battle damaged' (a figure version) does not count as box damage.
